svg.aria-label: Star schema of the Power BI model: fact_sales in the middle (110,197 rows, one row per item sold), and four dimensions joined to it many to one: dim_date (1,096 days) on order_date, dim_product (32,951 rows) on product_id, dim_seller (3,095 rows) on seller_id and dim_customer (99,441 rows) on customer_id. report_settings (1 row, the top-N values) and _Measures (23 DAX measures) join nothing. Every column is listed with its type and PK or FK mark.
svg.title: Sales performance star schema

g.text: PK primary key · FK foreign key · crow's foot = many, bar = one · blue fact, green dimension, grey joins nothing
